# Bright Data

Bright Data provides the world's #1 web data platform with Web Unlocker for bypassing anti-bot systems, SERP API for search engine data, and pre-made scrapers for popular websites. Collect any web data at scale.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/brightdata/.

## Actions

- **Browse Available Scrapers** (read-only): List all available pre-made scrapers (datasets) from bright data's marketplace.
- **Download Scraped Data** (read-only): Retrieve the scraped data from a completed crawl job by snapshot id.
- **SERP Search**: Perform serp (search engine results page) searches across different search engines.
- **Trigger Site Crawl**: Trigger a site crawl job to extract content across multiple pages or entire domains.
- **Web Unlocker**: Bypass bot detection, captcha, and other anti-scraping measures to extract content from websites.
- **Check Crawl Status** (read-only): Check the processing status of a crawl job using snapshot id.
- **Filter Dataset**: Apply custom filter criteria to a marketplace dataset (beta).
- **Get Available Cities** (read-only): Get available static network cities for a given country.
- **Get Available Countries** (read-only): List available countries and their iso 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.
- **List Unlocker Zones** (read-only): List your configured web unlocker zones and proxy endpoints.
